adjudication.evidence: P1 (542-546) shows no sustained offset: N/E/U shift is transient and not followed by opposing return; interior points vary smoothly without platform behavior. P2 (548) is a single-point spike, not a platform; no persistent offset. P3 (549-603) begins after a large jump at index 548–549 (N from ~6 to ~13.5, E from ~2.5 to ~4.3, U from ~-2.5 to ~-11.2), but the subsequent interval (549–603) shows monotonic drift in N/E/U without a clear opposing return—U recovers only partially (~-11 to -7), N/E do not revert. No sustained temporary platform exists; apparent offsets are part of permanent step + motion. Independent step at 548 likely explains onset; no genuine temporary platform.
